subject.title: [Feature Request]: Session snapshots — save and load context checkpoints (/session save|load)

question: Should named snapshots become a branch-first core session capability, and should destructive replacement of the active session be supported at all?
rationale: Existing primitives do not settle persistence ownership, destructive restore semantics, retained model metadata, archive handling, authorization, or the intended chat, CLI, and UI scope.

options.title: Branch-First Snapshots
options.body: Add immutable named checkpoints that create a new session branch by default, deferring destructive replacement or requiring a separate explicit action.

options.title: Full Save and Load
options.body: Allow snapshots to replace the active session after explicit confirmation and strict transcript, model, provider, and metadata validation.

options.title: Keep Recovery Narrow
options.body: Retain only compaction recovery and ordinary prior-session resume rather than introducing general named snapshots.

recommendation.title: Branch-First Snapshots
recommendation.body: Add immutable named checkpoints that create a new session branch by default, deferring destructive replacement or requiring a separate explicit action.
